scientific_queries.note: Give the tree a fair chance, sweeping capacity and adding native categorical handling, before hardening or withdrawing C106.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round discharges a caveat the previous round attached to its own claim.

the_fair_chance_was_real.reading: the tree improved substantially without the coarsening, so the absence of substitution is not a capacity artefact

two_side_findings.categorical_full_identity_zero: with native categorical splits the coarsening adds -0.0000, the tree analogue of the ridge zero: redundant once the drug is itself a native category
two_side_findings.categorical_absent_negative: the coarsening gives -0.0311 but the gain-difference interval [-0.0978, +0.0001] just includes zero, so it is recorded as an anomaly and not as harm

what_C106_becomes.before: the monotone decay is a linear-model property, with the caveat that the tree was untuned
what_C106_becomes.after: the caveat is discharged; substitution is specific to the linear model family, holding the features fixed
what_C106_becomes.still_open: no configuration puts both models in one framework, so the mechanism behind the difference remains descriptive

limits: twenty splits, so power is limited and the absent-case intervals are wide
the reserved category id is one encoding of a missing identity
the categorical absent-case negative value is not significant and must not be read as a finding
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: close this line: three configurations failed to recover substitution for the tree, so further hyperparameter work would be repetition
